text_block_list.text:
One day, Мэдзиро МакКуин decides to
participate
in a scrimmage at the
academy as part of her
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: So I placed second, huh...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I gave it everything I had, but when it
comes to
competing on a straight track...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Ever since Мэдзиро МакКуин's debut race,
we've
been training for the spring Tenno
Sho, just as she
requested.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With this being such a long-term plan,
our focus
is centered on basic fitness
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Say, is that the Mejiro prodigy? I heard
she's
got a lot of talent, but...
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I'm not convinced. Her
reactions were
bad, and she didn't
handle the race so well.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Oh, her? I think she's still on a basic
training
routine.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B

text_block_list.text: Huh? Basic training?
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
That's probably why she couldn't react
when she
needed to.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
Postponing the kind of hands-on training
needed
to win, huh? That takes a lot of
confidence.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Probably. But at this rate, she won't be
prepared
for next year's Classics.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't do that to my racers. All of
mine have
their hearts set to compete.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
They have a point. The current regimen
I've set
ignores the challenges she'll face
in the short
term.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, her innate abilities will help
pull her
through in the end. I'm sure she
understands this
as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hellooo! Is something the
matter? You
were staring off into space.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Is that so?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The next day, after training, Mejiro
McQueen
says she has something to talk
to me about.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer... Could you take a look at
this?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин shows me a piece of
paper.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It's a new training regimen I thought of.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I know that long-term strength
development is
important, but I thought
maybe we should
consider how to win
the junior-year races as well.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
She seems somewhat unsure of herself.
Hmm, I
wonder...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Did someone say something to you?

text_block_list.text: ...! N-no, that's not...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
A-anyway, please give some thought to
the
training regimen!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин leaves, almost like
she's running
away...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Hm? That you, McQueen?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Oh... Ryan...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Why the long face?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh right, you were in the scrimmage
yesterday...
Is it something about that?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: To tell you the truth... Well...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
My trainer seems to be enduring
criticism on my
account.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан listens to Мэдзиро МакКуин's

concerns.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Ohh, I get it. So that's why you asked
to change
your training regimen.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But is that really what you and your
trainer want?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You promised each other to give it your
all for
the Tenno Sho, right?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I figured you'd wanna keep that promise.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Both you and your trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It's likely that Мэдзиро МакКуин made
that
proposal to protect my reputation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But that shouldn't be her concern.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I can't be the reason she's holding herself back!

text_block_list.text:
The next day, I decide to talk with
Mejiro
McQueen again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: When I do...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer, I am so sorry!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Please disregard the training regimen I
put forth
yesterday!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
That was, well... It was not an act of
sincerity.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: I thought that might be the case.

text_block_list.text: S-so you noticed?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
In truth, I'm fine with the current
regimen.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
After all, the two of us promised we'd
aim for the
Tenno Sho together!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: Then there's no need to doubt ourselves.

text_block_list.text:
Yes! I shall continue to devote my
efforts to
winning the Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
No matter what other people say, we
shouldn't
change our goal. Mejiro
McQueen and I renew
our promise to
each other.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
